name: ProtoTypePicker
description: Searchable dropdown for choosing a protobuf message type from the loaded registry, used by every row of ProtoBindingRulesForm.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently chosen message type; empty renders the 'Choose a type' placeholder.

props.name: descriptorNames
props.description: Full message-type names available from the loaded proto registry. Empty renders the 'No types loaded' empty state.

notes: Extracted from a ProtoBindingRulesForm {#snippet} so the codebase stays on legacy Svelte syntax. Filter text is local component state, so each picker instance keeps its own search and the parent needs no per-row map. ProtoBindingRulesForm's spec deliberately omits this from its dependencies[]: both are tier 'component' and the validator only allows component -> primitive edges. Extracting a generic SearchableDropdownMenu primitive shared with AddToCollectionMenu is the follow-up.
